 Super Eagle AFCON chase continues
The Super Eagles are back in the race for the Africa Cup of Nations and the qualification journey is heating up! After a crucial 3-1 victory in the first leg against Tanzania, the team is focused on securing another win to boost their AFCON hopes.
 With Ademola Lookman sidelined due to injury, expect tactical changes from coach Eric Chelle. Tolu Awooniyi and Al-Assan Yusuf were instrumental in the first leg, and Awooniyi might even earn a starting spot alongside Akpo Adams for the upcoming match.
 The Super Eagles can’t afford any slip-ups after their previous defeat. With only one AFCON ticket available from this group, every remaining game is vital for their qualification.
